required_changes: Add an explicit environment-scope caution to the candidate and reporting concept update. The export overview says one destination spans Production and Sandbox, while only the two draft-breakdown examples add environment_type = 'PRODUCTION'. State that the other cookbook counts and totals are not environment-scoped as written, and require the intended per-table environment predicate before interpreting them as production metrics.

Carry the documented delivery and draft-grain boundaries into the candidate and shared cautions. Object-storage exports are append-only and at-least-once, so repeated primary keys from updates or retries require latest-row resolution before aggregation; a global maximum snapshot is not a substitute for per-key deduplication or a per-object completeness guarantee. The draft_invoice reference also permits DRAFT_INCOMPLETE rows with no total or line items, so explain that COUNT may include incomplete rows while SUM ignores null totals unless status and completeness are handled.

Strengthen the contracts/rate-card qualification. Keep the correct observation that descending updated_at does not return only one override. Also state that the query titled active rate-card entries checks only ending_before > NOW(), omits starting_at, does not define nullable ending_before handling, and does not select among version or snapshot rows; do not present it as a complete current-state count without reconciling the database-reference grain.

Retain the total/100 warning but link the direct denomination authority, [[metronome-currencies-and-custom-pricing-units]] and/or [[source-metronome-guides-pricing-packaging-make-pricing-changes-use-currency-custompricingunits]]. Preserve that Metronome documents USD API values in cents but listed non-USD fiat in whole units, so the cookbook alias total_dollars cannot establish a universal divide-by-100 rule. Keep this separate from export delivery and invoice-status concerns.

Update data-export-cookbook-query-patterns and data-export-cookbook-query-contradictions so their canonical prose includes the environment, at-least-once deduplication, DRAFT_INCOMPLETE, and rate-card version/effective-time boundaries above. Retain the existing finalized-versus-void, missing-seven-day-filter, and strict-grouping warnings. The reciprocal source link can be approved only after its status, snapshot, aggregation, and currency description points to corrected concept content.
